content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** GOVLAW — **deviation** (redline proposed at the preferred level).

- **Governing law (preferred element 1) is already met:** Section 15.5 (p0627) applies New York law, and the Letter Agreement (p0671) mirrors it.
- **Forum fails both preferred and fallback:** Section 15.6(a) (p0629) mandates confidential JAMS arbitration in a redacted seat before redacted arbitrators — not New York County courts (preferred), nor Delaware/California/London courts (fallback). Only award enforcement, the IP-registration carve-out (15.6(h)) and interim relief (15.6(j)) go to courts.
- **Cure (validated, ok:true):** one surgical replace in 15.6(a) substituting the arbitration referral with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County and switching off 15.6(b)–(e); plus short conforming edits to the sentence remainder (p0630), the punitive-damages waiver (p0635, substance preserved), the stay-of-termination protection (p0636, preserved and re-pointed to court proceedings), and the interim injunctive-relief carve-out (p0639, narrowed to temporary/interim injunctive relief so exclusivity holds). No arbitration mechanic or cross-reference is left dangling; 15.6(h)/(i) IP-specific mechanics are retained and noted only.
